gloss: grilling on a wire net; net-grilled

definitions.gloss: grilling on a wire net; net-grilled; grilled over an open flame on a rack
definitions.explanation: A cooking method where food is placed on a wire mesh or grill rack and cooked over direct heat, typically charcoal. Also refers to food prepared this way.

⟦{炭火|すみび}→炭火：25320_sumibi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{網焼|あみや}きにした⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Vegetables grilled on a net over charcoal are delicious.

notes:
COOKING:
{網焼|あみや}き is a traditional Japanese grilling method using a metal grate (⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧) placed directly over a heat source. It produces a distinctive charred flavor and is commonly used for fish, meat, and vegetables.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{炭火|すみび}→炭火：25320_sumibi⟧{網焼|あみや}き (charcoal net-grilling)
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{網焼|あみや}き (net-grilled fish)
- {網焼|あみや}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to grill on a net)
